title: RC16 Native Feature Supply: Calendar Decay or Volatility Conditioning

research_height.transfer_path: Monthly availability of the unchanged native RC16 compression feature determines its opportunity supply; persistent calendar decay would constrain component and portfolio turnover independently of admission, while volatility conditioning would preserve the signal and relocate the bottleneck.

central_question: Did native 13:30 RC16 signal availability materially decay from 2025 into completed 2026 months after removing the association with pre-decision realized volatility?

research_bundle.name: annual_supply_ratio_monthly_volatility_mechanism_and_partial_calendar_falsification
lenses: supply quantity: exact native eligible days, signals and annual rate ratio
market mechanism: monthly signal rate association with median pre-decision ATR divided by price
falsification: partial calendar correlation with monthly signal rate after linear residualization on log volatility

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo's claim that the full turnover target is structurally unreachable is narrowed before outcomes. This unit can identify only observed RC16 native supply decay over nineteen months, not whole-portfolio impossibility.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 063 found 79 native signals over 258 eligible 2025 days and 39 over 151 completed-month 2026 days, while broad all-slot expansion failed. Whether the lower rate is calendar decay or volatility-conditioned supply remains unresolved.
why_now.connection_bridge: Unit 079 found unstable lifecycle-level cost/time association and left Unit 039 unchanged, so cost shaping does not currently resolve the turnover question. The same immutable bar path has an unused causal role as native signal supply rather than cost context.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 079 was Program 7 cost-evidence diagnosis at lifecycle endpoints. Unit 080 moves to Program 1 pre-entry feature availability, uses monthly opportunity counts and pre-decision volatility, and transfers to macro turnover feasibility without touching admission.
why_now.decision_if_true: Preserve native RC16 unchanged but mark its opportunity supply as observed calendar-decaying beyond volatility; retain only a non-automatic future research-allocation seed favoring genuinely new signal mechanisms over RC16 clock expansion.
why_now.decision_if_false: Discard the calendar-decay explanation, preserve native RC16 supply as volatility-conditioned, and keep admission/portfolio composition—not RC16 secular scarcity—as the turnover bottleneck.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Make no signal, clock, turnover or research-allocation change; record the bounded limitation and rotate away.

frozen_daily_reconstruction.information_set: At exact evaluation index i use completed physical bars i-112 through i-1 only.
frozen_daily_reconstruction.prior_range_samples: For sample 0 through 95, log(max high over sample:sample+16 divided by min low over the same 16 bars).
frozen_daily_reconstruction.normal_range: Median of the 96 samples, averaging the two central sorted values.
frozen_daily_reconstruction.current_range: Log high-low range over completed-bar indices 96 through 111.
frozen_daily_reconstruction.signed_tightness: sign(direction_return) divided by current_range/normal_range, or exactly zero when direction_return is zero.
frozen_daily_reconstruction.predecision_atr_fraction: Arithmetic ATR14 from completed bars i-14 through i-1 using the preceding close for true range, divided by open[i].

frozen_monthly_and_partial_metrics.monthly_rows: For each of nineteen calendar months report eligible native days, signal count, signal rate and median daily predecision_atr_fraction.
frozen_monthly_and_partial_metrics.annual_rate_ratio: 2026 January-July pooled signal rate divided by full-2025 pooled signal rate.
frozen_monthly_and_partial_metrics.volatility_association: Pearson correlation across nineteen monthly rows between signal rate and log monthly median ATR fraction.
frozen_monthly_and_partial_metrics.partial_calendar_correlation: Residualize monthly signal rate on an intercept plus log median ATR fraction; separately residualize zero-based month index on the same predictor; take Pearson correlation of the two residual vectors.
frozen_monthly_and_partial_metrics.no_significance_claim: The partial correlation is a fixed effect-size diagnostic over nineteen months, not a population p-value.

requirements: All six byte/hash pins and Unit 063 schema/verdict/count anchors pass.

Monthly signal-rate, log-volatility and month-index vectors each have positive variance and all correlations are finite.
The 2026-to-2025 annual signal-rate ratio is at most 0.80.
Partial calendar correlation after log-volatility residualization is at most -0.50.

decision_translation.complete: Preserve RC16 unchanged and retain one non-automatic future research-allocation seed favoring a genuinely new signal mechanism over another RC16 clock expansion. Do not implement a component here.
